features.title: Extract an editable ingredient list from a fridge photo
features.intent: Uploading a clear fridge photo yields an editable ingredient list within 15 seconds.
features.serves: journey step 2: the app extracts an ingredient list and shows it for one-tap correction
acceptance: Uploading a clear fridge photo produces an editable ingredient list within 15 seconds.

features.title: Suggest three cookable recipes
features.intent: Confirming the list yields exactly three recipe suggestions, each cookable with the confirmed ingredients plus pantry staples.
features.serves: REQ-AC2: three suggestions cookable with confirmed inventory plus staples
acceptance: Confirming an ingredient list returns exactly three recipes, each cookable with those ingredients plus pantry staples.

features.title: Handle a photo with no recognizable food
features.intent: A photo with no recognizable food produces a helpful empty state, not a crash or a hallucinated list.
features.serves: REQ-AC4: unusable photos must degrade gracefully
acceptance: Uploading a photo with no recognizable food shows a helpful empty state instead of crashing or hallucinating ingredients.
